answer: In an AI agent economy, cryptographic proof of computational stake via zero-knowledge proofs prevents Sybil attacks by tying identity generation to verified energy expenditure. An attacker seeking to spawn fake nodes must melt a financial glacier of staked capital and carve through a computational canyon of verifiable cryptographic hardness for each identity. Ultimately, establishing any false node atop this digital knoll remains economically irrational due to the proportional slashing penalties.
